# Svdash

> An accessible SaaS dashboard component library for Svelte 5, TypeScript and Tailwind
> CSS v4 — 69 components, every one matching its WAI-ARIA APG pattern and
> verified against axe. Use llms-full.txt for the complete design contract before
> generating UI meant to match this system.

## Design contract

- [Full design reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebnsina/svdash/main/llms-full.txt): tokens, radius and shadow rules, type scale, accessibility contract and component API conventions — everything needed to generate matching UI
- [Design tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebnsina/svdash/main/src/lib/tokens.css): the single source of truth for colour, radius, shadow and type in both themes
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebnsina/svdash/main/README.md): the reasoning behind each decision

## Code

- [Component source](https://github.com/ebnsina/svdash/tree/main/src/lib/components): grouped by layout, navigation, data-display, forms, feedback, buttons, settings, auth
- [Shared utilities](https://github.com/ebnsina/svdash/tree/main/src/lib/utils): class joining, focus trap, click-outside, Intl formatters
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebnsina/svdash/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Optional

- [Storybook stories](https://github.com/ebnsina/svdash/tree/main/src/lib/components): each component's states, co-located as `*.stories.svelte`
